Closes #2953

This renames the six cards (eight catalog entries) from #2953 on every platform. Ids, costs, stats, effects, tags (Super-Virus keeps `CN`), pictures and voice lines are unchanged. One file name is held back for a follow-up (see "Departure from the plan").

| Id | Was | Now | 中文 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `core-002` | Bigot | Speciesist | 物种歧视者 |
| `traininggrounds-041` | Legacy: Bigot | Legacy: Speciesist | 传统：物种歧视者 |
| `traininggrounds-029` | Oriental | Easterner | 东方人 (unchanged; it already means Easterner) |
| `stinkyscape-044` | Great Replacement Theory | Great Paperclip Theory | 大回形针理论 |
| `core-042` | Eugenics | Selective Breeding | 选择性育种 |
| `core-090` | CN-Viral Injection | Super-Virus Injection | 超级病毒注射 |
| `core-090-1` | CN-Virus | Super-Virus | 超级病毒 |
| `meditative-061` | Joon Jorker | Joon Juicer | 俊·榨汁机 |

## What changed

- **`crates/cards/catalog.json`:** 13 lines changed, and nothing else in the file.
  - The 8 names.
  - `stinkyscape-088` Radiant: "Fill your hand with Speciesists."
  - `meditative-095-1` base and Radiant: `{viruses|Super-Virus|Super-Viruses}`.
  - `core-090` base and Radiant: "Shuffle a (Radiant) Super-Virus into your opponent's deck."
  - The plan said 14 lines; 8 + 2 + 2 + 1 is 13.
- **`card-text.yaml`:** the name comments and the Chinese names. `chinese.json` was regenerated by `export_card_text`. `flavour.json` and `voice-text.json` did not change, and `card-audio.json5` changed only in its comments, so no audio is owed.
- **Seven script files renamed with `git mv`:** `c002_speciesist`, `c090_super_virus_injection`, `c090_1_super_virus`, `c061_joon_juicer`, `c044_great_paperclip_theory`, `c029_easterner` and `c041_speciesist`. Their headers, constants, test modules and test names follow, and so does every `proven_in` path that named them.
- **The new names everywhere that describes the live game:**
  - the web app and e2e (tests, fixture decks, comments) and the fx tables;
  - the engine, AI, server and tools tests and fixtures (`fx-super-virus`);
  - the spec's section and ruling notes (the folded §11 paragraphs are edited where they stand);
  - the set docs, `ADDING_CARDS.md` §4, `BUILD.md` and `REVIEW.md`;
  - `CLAUDE.md`'s `c002_speciesist` example, with its comment column realigned;
  - the designer's notes `JackiOh_*.md`.
- **Pictures are unchanged (R503):**
  - `motifs.ts`'s helix row now matches `breed*` instead of `eugenic*`. Selective Breeding is the only card name with such a word.
  - `traininggrounds.ts`'s recruit word is now `easterner`.
  - A throwaway node script drew every renamed card's base and Radiant picture twice: with HEAD's art modules and the old names, and with the new modules and the new names. All 22 pairs came out byte-identical.
- **New fragment** `crates/cards/patches/pending/rename-six-cards-whose-names-wouldn-t-pass-roblox-moderation.json`:
  - it claims the 10 changed entries, with `--visual`;
  - its player note is written by hand and shows only the new names.
- **Tests changed where a name was the point:**
  - **R279 (`references.rs`):** the new token name is a whole word of its card's name, so the "longer word" case is now `"shuffle two Super-Viruses into"`.
  - **R711000 name sort (`filters.test.ts`):** Speciesist now sorts last in both English and Chinese, so the test would prove nothing. It uses `core-017` Flood (洪水) instead; I checked the orders with `localeCompare`.
  - **Own-library lists (`c090_super_virus_injection.rs`, `c095_1_cn_golem.rs`):** at cost 1 the list goes by name (R310), and Super-Virus now sorts after Stockpile, so the expected order is swapped.
  - **Sandbox search (`sandbox.test.ts`):** it searched `"BIGO"`, which the rename patterns missed; it now searches `"SPECIE"`.

## Departure from the plan: `c042_eugenics.rs` keeps its file name

Core #42's script is still `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c042_eugenics.rs` (module `c042_eugenics`). Its contents are renamed: header, `SELECTIVE_BREEDING_MAX_COST`, `fn selective_breeding`, test names and seeds.

- **Why the file name matters to CI:**
  - `crates/cards/src/history.rs` names that module in `KEPT_SCRIPTS`, and `classify` counts that file as play code. Renaming the module makes `rust (classify)` play 200 unforced games against `main`.
  - Card names are part of the game state and the view: the own library is sorted by cost then name (R310), and prompt labels and fused cards' names carry them. So those games' hashes differ wherever a renamed card shows up, even though every recorded action replays on the base build.
- **What happened with the full rename:** `classify --claims` failed with 22 problems. It wanted `--plays` for 21 cards that did not change, plus `--rule`, because 65 of the 200 games had a divergence no card explains.
- **Why I didn't just add those claims:** `--rule` makes this a **patch**, not a micro, and `patches ship` runs automatically after merge. Per `wire/stats/window.rs`, a patch opens a new statistics window for every card. The issue asked for a micro.
- **With history.rs untouched**, the same run reports `Cards, micro` with no problems.

**A person should file a follow-up:** rename `c042_eugenics.rs` to `c042_selective_breeding.rs`, together with `history.rs:34,182` and `proven_in` in R0311, R1438, R1748003 and R831014. Once this PR has merged, both builds carry the new names, so that change classifies as Internal and needs no fragment. The alternative I rejected was the full rename plus `--plays` (21 ids) and `--rule`.

## Remaining hits of the old names, and why they stay

- **`crates/cards/patches/**`:** the shipped snapshots and `patches.json`, which replays fold under, plus the new fragment's `notes`, which map old names to new.
- **`training/history/`:** historical records.
- **`crates/server/news.json`:** the v0.5.8 patch announcement ("like Legacy: Bigot"), which is a past patch note.
- **`spec/INDEX.md`:** four rows. spec-fold rewrites this file from the notes on `main`, and no branch runs `spec index`.
- **`bot/`:** five files no bot may change.
- **`docs/v0.4.0/README.md:465`:** `luau_core_002_bigot`, the name of a test that #2579 retired.
- **`c042_eugenics`:** the file itself, `history.rs` and the four `proven_in` lines, as explained above.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

1. **`core-090`'s own text changes too**, because it names its token, and R279's references need the token's name in it. Rejected: leaving "CN-Virus" in it.
2. **The Chinese names follow the English ones**, as in the table. Rejected: keeping the old Chinese names.
3. **The player note shows only the new names.** Rejected: showing the old names to players.
4. **Seed strings that held an old name are renamed.** None of them changed a test's roll.

## How I tested it

`classify` reads the commit at `--head` and the checkout its binary was built from, so on an uncommitted tree it compares base with base and reports Internal. I therefore ran it in a scratch worktree holding a snapshot commit of this tree, with a binary built there, against a base binary built from `origin/main`. Both worktrees are removed.

- **`classify --base origin/main --parent-bin <base> --claims`:**
  - final tree: `Cards, micro`; the only families that play differently are the nine renamed families, all claimed; exit 0;
  - full rename: 22 problems, as described above.
- **`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts --no-fail-fast`:** 41 binaries, 17,717 passed, 0 failed. The only change in `apps/web/src/wire` is the one doc line in `GameEvent.ts`, which matches what ts-rs writes.
- **Formatting and lint:** `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean.
- **`cargo jackioh` checks:**
  - `catalog check`: `validate-catalog: OK`;
  - `patches check`: ok;
  - `spec check`: `1663 rulings … ok`;
  - `golden check`: `hotseat fixture: folds to 972f5b85`.
- **Fuzz** (run with the snapshot binary): `fuzz --seeds 200` gave 200 passed, 0 failed, and so did `fuzz --seeds 200 --cards` with the 9 renamed families forced in.
- **Web and e2e:**
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` (43 fixtures OK), the component `tsc`, and eslint on the 38 changed web and e2e files all passed.
  - The full `vitest run` gave 9,372 passed and 7 failed. One was the `BIGO` test, now fixed. The other six timed out while the cargo tests were loading the machine. All six files (371 tests) pass when rerun on their own, together with `filters.test.ts` and `sandbox.test.ts`.
- **Not run:** the Cypress e2e specs and the Postgres suites. The only server-side change under `crates/server/tests/sql` is one SQL comment.

**Worth a second look:** the c042 departure; the `.test.ts` files and the fx and e2e fixtures (edited by the bulk rename); and `references.rs` R279, whose example changed meaning.

### What it does

These names would fail Roblox's Community Standards (#2898, "Card content"), so they are renamed **on every platform, the web game included**. This is not a Roblox-only override. | `core-090` | CN-Viral Injection | **Super-Virus Injection** |
| `core-090-1` | CN-Virus (token) | **Super-Virus** |
| `meditative-061` | Joon Jorker | **Joon Juicer** |

These cards quote an old name in their text, base and Radiant faces both:

- `stinkyscape-088` Siva 2, Radiant: "Fill your hand with Bigots." becomes "Fill your hand with Speciesists."
- `meditative-095-1` CN Golem: `{viruses|CN-Virus|CN-Viruses}` becomes `{viruses|Super-Virus|Super-Viruses}`.

Occidental (`traininggrounds-028`) is out of scope: it keeps its name. Super-Virus keeps its `CN` tag.

**Where the names change.** Change them everywhere that describes the live game: `crates/cards/catalog.json`, the card scripts' header comments and `ID` context, the scripts' file and test-module names (for example `c002_bigot.rs` becomes `c002_speciesist.rs`, and `mod tests` names that hold the old name), `apps/web` (including the `card-audio.json5` and `card-text.yaml` comments, `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §4 "A renamed card"), `e2e`, `crates/engine`, `crates/ai` and `crates/server` fixtures and tests, `spec/` (section notes and ruling notes, with every `proven_in` path that names a renamed file), the set docs under `docs/`, and the designer's notes `JackiOh_*.md`, so that REVIEW Part A sees no mismatch.

**Where they don't.** Leave historical records as they are: the shipped catalog snapshots and `patches.json` in `crates/cards/patches/` (replays fold under them), `reviews/`, `training/history/` and past patch notes. Rule ids stay as they are, and no new ruling is needed.

### Acceptance

- `catalog.json` carries the eight new names and the two text changes above; nothing else in the catalog changes.
- After the change, a grep over `crates/`, `apps/`, `e2e/`, `spec/` and `docs/` for the old names hits only the historical records listed above, if anything. The pull request lists any remaining hit and why it stays.
